fields.label: Payment Method Mappings
fields.description: Map any ERPNext Mode of Payment to Cash, Manual / Non-Cash, Electronic Payment, or Physical Payment Terminal. Blank POS Profile applies to all profiles. Mappings take priority over the legacy defaults below.

fields.label: Legacy / Fallback Defaults
fields.description: Used only when a Mode of Payment has no row in Payment Method Mappings.

fields.label: Fallback Payment Link Lifetime (Minutes)
fields.description: Optional global fallback used only when a payment provider does not return its own expiry. Provider-reported expiry always wins. Leave blank/0 to use the provider's native/default expiry behavior.

fields.label: Pending Sale Retention (Hours)
fields.description: How long an unpaid/failed POS Payment Session remains recoverable for a new payment attempt or draft printing. Captured money is never auto-expired.

fields.label: WhatsApp Account (Optional)
fields.description: Name of the outgoing WhatsApp Account in frappe_whatsapp. Leave blank to use its default outgoing account.

fields.label: Payment Link WhatsApp Template
fields.description: Optional approved frappe_whatsapp template. Recommended when initiating a conversation outside Meta's 24-hour service window.

fields.label: Custom WhatsApp Sender Method
fields.description: Optional dotted Python method. Called with to, message, reference_doctype, reference_name, allocation and session.

fields.label: Payment Link Message Template
Draft A4 Print Format
fields.description: A4 print format used by Payment Hub for unpaid or partially paid draft invoices. Leave blank to fall back to Default POS Print Format.

fields.label: Draft Receipt Print Format
fields.description: Thermal/receipt print format used by Payment Hub for unpaid or partially paid draft invoices. Leave blank to fall back to Default POS Print Format.

fields.label: Final Receipt Print Format
fields.description: Preferred receipt print format after a Payment Hub sale is completed. POS adapters may continue to use their own final receipt setting when configured.

Require Manager Authorization for Physical Terminal Refund
Allow Authorized Refund Method Override
fields.description: Requires Payment Hub Refund Override role and manager/admin password. v0.5.0 permits override to the configured Cash Mode of Payment only.
